# Provenance

`input.hea` and `monitor.dat` are derived from sample 01 in the MedOmni family sample set. The source is a deidentified MIMIC waveform record for subject `p<subject>` with leads II, V, and aVR. The published 62.4725 Hz excerpt was resampled by four to the declared 249.89 Hz family rate. MIMIC data use remains subject to the PhysioNet credentialed data agreement.
